say:2:1710655002:1.text: Your Highness, I apologize that the beast endangered everyone... I nearly arrived late.
say:2:1710655002:1.source_cn: 殿下，让巨蛛冲撞了各位……我来迟了。

say:3:1710655003:1.text: Not at all. Your timing was perfect.
say:3:1710655003:1.source_cn: 怎么会……你来得恰逢其时。

say:4:1710655004:1.text: Your skill has grown since we last met. That precise shot was admirable.
say:4:1710655004:1.source_cn: 与上次见面相比，你的箭术越发精进了。那精准的一击，令人赞叹。

say:5:1710655005:1.text: Hendrik mentioned your recent duties, so I didn't wish to trouble you. Now I see failing to invite such talent to the hunt was my loss.
say:5:1710655005:1.source_cn: 听亨德里克卿说你最近公务缠身，我就没让人去打扰你。现在...

say:6:1710655006:1.text: And Magister Merlin... a rare honor to have you here. Perhaps hunting has caught your interest?
say:6:1710655006:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下也在这里……真是罕见的贵客。莫非，您也对行猎感兴趣？
say:6:1710655006:1.male: And Magister Merlin... a rare honor to have you here. Perhaps hunting has caught your interest?
say:6:1710655006:1.female: And Magister Merlin... a rare honor to have you here. Perhaps hunting has caught your interest?

say:7:1710655007:1.text: Your Highness, that's a misunderstanding... actually, we—

choice_prompt:8:1710655007.text: Your Highness, that's a misunderstanding... actually, we—

say:9:1710655008:1.text: Heh, you flatter me. It's just an ordinary hunt.
say:9:1710655008:1.source_cn: 呵，梅林阁下过誉了。不过是寻常的行猎活动罢了。
say:9:1710655008:1.male: Heh, you flatter me. It's just an ordinary hunt.
say:9:1710655008:1.female: Heh, you flatter me. It's just an ordinary hunt.

say:11:1710655012:1.text: Just then, a guard approaches and salutes, cutting the awkward exchange short.
say:11:1710655012:1.source_cn: 正在此刻，一旁的守备军行礼后上前来，打断了你们尴尬的寒暄。
say:11:1710655012:1.male: Just then, a guard approaches and salutes, cutting the awkward exchange short.
say:11:1710655012:1.female: Just then, a guard approaches and salutes, cutting the awkward exchange short.

say:13:1710655013:1.text: Your Highness, the guests are badly shaken. Should the hunt continue?
say:13:1710655013:1.source_cn: 王子殿下，各位宾客都受到了不小的惊吓，此次行猎……还要...

say:14:1710655014:1.text: Cancel it. Fetch physicians and remedies for everyone. I will see to our guests myself.
say:14:1710655014:1.source_cn: 不必了，去给宾客们准备好伤药和医师。我要亲自去安抚诸位大人。

say:16:1710655015:1.text: You two, rest here. You've earned it. I have an announcement to make shortly.
say:16:1710655015:1.source_cn: 两位此次猎杀魔物有功，请在这暂作休息。稍后，我有一件事...

say:18:1710655016:1.text: Your Highness, allow me to help secure the camp. I'll prevent more monsters from approaching.
say:18:1710655016:1.source_cn: 殿下，我可以协助维持营地秩序，确保不会再有魔物靠近。

choice_prompt:19:1710655016.text: Your Highness, allow me to help secure the camp. I'll prevent more monsters from approaching.
choice_prompt:19:1710655016.source_cn: 殿下，我可以协助维持营地秩序，确保不会再有魔物靠近。

say:20:1710655017:1.text: Very well. I leave it in your hands.
say:20:1710655017:1.source_cn: 既然如此，那就劳烦两位了。
say:20:1710655017:1.male: Very well. I leave it in your hands.
say:20:1710655017:1.female: Very well. I leave it in your hands.

choice:19:0:1.text: I can tend to the wounded.
choice:19:0:1.source_cn: 我可以去救治受伤的人
choice:19:0:1.male: I can tend to the wounded.
choice:19:0:1.female: I can tend to the wounded.

choice:8:0:1.text: I wished to see the Prince in action.
choice:8:0:1.male: I wished to see the Prince in action.
choice:8:0:1.female: I wished to see the Prince in action.

say:22:1710655009:1.text: Oh? Once things are settled, I'll invite you to the next hunt.
say:22:1710655009:1.source_cn: 哦？确实是我的疏忽。等此次危机解除，我定会邀请阁下参与...
say:22:1710655009:1.male: Oh? Once things are settled, I'll invite you to the next hunt.
say:22:1710655009:1.female: Oh? Once things are settled, I'll invite you to the next hunt.

choice:8:1:2.text: I really am interested in hunting.
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 我确实对行猎很有兴趣
choice:8:1:2.male: I really am interested in hunting.
choice:8:1:2.female: I really am interested in hunting.

say:23:1710655010:1.text: Is that so? I'm glad you've safely retrieved your companion.
say:23:1710655010:1.source_cn: 是吗？你能平安无事地找回宠物，实在是再好不过了。
say:23:1710655010:1.male: Is that so? I'm glad you've safely retrieved your companion.
say:23:1710655010:1.female: Is that so? I'm glad you've safely retrieved your companion.

choice:8:2:3.text: I was looking for my lost fox!
choice:8:2:3.source_cn: 我来找走丢的宠物——这只狐狸！
choice:8:2:3.male: I was looking for my lost fox!
choice:8:2:3.female: I was looking for my lost fox!
